taxonomy.title: Workload and capacity
taxonomy.description: Volume of work, deadlines, after-hours effort and team capacity.

taxonomy.title: Tools and developer environment
taxonomy.description: Build speed, environments, laptops and access to useful tools including AI assistants.

taxonomy.title: Leadership communication and priorities
taxonomy.description: Clarity of direction, how priorities are set and how decisions are communicated.

taxonomy.title: Recognition and feeling valued
taxonomy.description: Whether effort is noticed, thanked and credited.

taxonomy.title: Flexible and hybrid work
taxonomy.description: Working from home, office days, commuting and flexibility.

taxonomy.title: Release and change-control process
taxonomy.description: Release approvals, change paperwork and process overhead.

items.text: Workload has been crushing, overtime most nights to meet the deadline.
Capacity is fine this sprint, good to have breathing room.
We keep getting weekend work requests and the team is tired.
Deadline was tight but the team handled it well, good effort.
Too much work and not enough people.
Local environment takes forever to start, the build tooling is slow.
The new AI coding tool is really helpful for writing tests.
VPN drops several times a day and blocks my work.
Happy with the new laptop, builds are much better now.
Pipeline failures with no logs are frustrating.
Priorities from leadership are unclear and change constantly.
The town hall explained the strategy well, good to hear the direction.
Decisions get made without communicating them to us.
My manager communicates priorities clearly, it is helpful.
Nobody explains why the direction changed.
Thank you to the team for the shout-out, I felt appreciated.
Our work on the launch was never recognised.
Credit for the migration went to another team, frustrating.
Leadership thanked us publicly, felt valued.
Nice to be appreciated for the late fix.
Working from home two days is great for me.
The commute on office days is hard and tiring.
Flexible hours make it easier to manage school pickup, thank you.
Hybrid rules are confusing and keep changing.
Remote days help me focus, I enjoy them.
Change record paperwork is a waste of time for small fixes.
The release approval process was smooth this time, good job.
CAB approval delays are frustrating.
Change window booking is confusing.
The new release checklist made the process better.
